# SR Enterprises

> SR Enterprises is a home appliance repair and installation business in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad), Maharashtra, India, established in 2013. Rated 4.9 stars on Google with a 90-day service warranty on all repairs.

SR Enterprises provides doorstep repair, installation, and servicing for air conditioners, washing machines, and refrigerators across Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar and Aurangabad, including CIDCO, Garkheda, Waluj, Osmanpura, and Bajaj Nagar.

## Services
- Split AC repair, window AC repair, and inverter AC repair
- AC installation and uninstallation
- AC gas refilling with leak detection
- AC servicing and deep cleaning
- Washing machine repair (fully automatic and semi-automatic, all major brands)
- Refrigerator and fridge repair (single door, double door, frost-free)
- Microwave repair
